definition: An assessment of the risks that arise from using the reviewed methods, such as misuse, dual use, or unsupported assurance, as distinct from the threats those methods address and from lists of open technical challenges. Y: a dedicated analysis with mitigations. P: an explicit but limited treatment. N: none.
method: Full text converted to plain text and searched, body only (reference lists excluded), for dual-use, misuse, ethics, responsible disclosure, malicious use and risk, and for section headings on ethics, risks, limitations and challenges. Every hit was read in context. Checked on 2026-11-17.
